title: Seattle Public School Closure for Budget Recovery
summary: This scenario evaluates which school would be least harmful to close under a hypothetical budget recovery plan.
description: The school district faces a budget shortfall and must compare possible school closure alternatives. Stakeholders rate the importance of criteria such as enrollment impact, budget allocation, budget per student, grade distribution, retention, and grade imbalance. The submitted preferences are stored for downstream AHP/Fuzzy AHP weighting and TOPSIS/Fuzzy TOPSIS ranking.
policy_question: Which school closure option produces the least negative impact while helping address district budget constraints?
